verdict.rationale: Maintenance activity is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. The pack shows only a pinned CLI version (0.4.1) and a single hosted data-path fix redeployed on 2026-10-08, with no release history or dates, no issue tracker or triage evidence, and no accepted community contributions.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection is actively maintained — recent releases, triaged issues, and accepted community contributions
